name: Denkoi ~Denwa Kara Hajimaru Koi~
original_name: デンコイ〜電話から始まる恋〜
source:
On her way home from university, Satou Amane picked up three lost phones. The moment she decided to deliver them to a police station, they all started ringing...?!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7721]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
佐藤天音在从大学回家的路上捡到了三部丢失的手机。当她决定把他们送到警察局的那一刻，他们都开始响了……？！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7721]NovelGame[/url]]
